description: Canonical Markov trace tr_M(β_atom)/tr_M(β_free) = Σ y_λ χ^λ for every atom, via the monotone-word fine-Bratteli transfer matrix (chi_monotone_transfer) + Jones-Markov y_λ. Canonical color-weighted p-n convention, q₀, 50 dps. Closes the A≥3 canonical-tr_M gap that needed Path-3/markov_peel — ⁶Li/⁷Li in seconds (no d_λ wall). Δtr_M = |tr_M_free|−|tr_M_atom| is the Path-3 binding baseline.
